## 1. Bash / Shell Script (Linux/macOS)

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# -----------------------------------------------------------
# deny-site.sh  –  Block access to one or more domains
# Usage: sudo ./deny-site.sh example.com another site.com
# -----------------------------------------------------------

# Check for root/administrative privileges
if [[ $EUID -ne 0 ]]; then
    echo "Please run this script as root (e.g., sudo)." >&2
    exit 1
fi

# No domains supplied?
if [[ $# -eq 0 ]]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 domain1 [domain2 ...]" >&2
    exit 1
fi

# Path to the hosts file
HOSTS_FILE="/etc/hosts"

# Loop over each supplied domain
for domain in "$@"; do
    # Trim any surrounding whitespace
    domain="$(echo -n "$domain" | xargs)"

    # Skip if already blocked
    if grep -q "^127\.0\.0\.1[[:space:]]+$domain" "$HOSTS_FILE" 2>/dev/null; then
        echo "{$domain} is already blocked."
        continue
    fi

    # Add the entry
    echo "Blocking $domain ..."
    echo "127.0.0.1     $domain" >> "$HOSTS_FILE"
done

echo "All done! The hosts file has been updated."
echo "You may need to flush DNS caches for changes to take effect."
echo "  Linux (systemd-resolved): sudo systemd-resolve --flush-caches"
echo "  macOS (10.10+): sudo dscacheutil -flushcache && sudo killall -HUP mDNSResponder"
```

<#
.SYNOPSIS
    Block one or more domains by adding entries to the Windows hosts file.

.DESCRIPTION
    This script appends lines of the form "127.0.0.1  <domain>" to
    C:\Windows\System32\drivers\etc\hosts. It requires Administrator
    privileges.

.PARAMETER Domains
    One or more domain names to block.

.EXAMPLE
    PS> .\Deny-Site.ps1 -Domains example.com, badsite.org
#>

[CmdletBinding()]
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory=$true, Position=0, ValueFromRemainingArguments=$true)]
    [string[]]$Domains
)

# Verify we are running as Administrator
if (-not ([Security.Principal.WindowsPrincipal] `
      [Security.Principal.WindowsIdentity]::GetCurrent()).IsInRole(`
      [Security.Principal.WindowsBuiltInRole] "Administrator")) {
    Write-Error "This script must be run with Administrator rights. Use Run as Administrator."
    exit 1
}

$hostsPath = "$env:SystemRoot\System32\drivers\etc\hosts"

# Ensure the hosts file exists
if (-not (Test-Path $hostsPath)) {
    Write-Error "Hosts file not found at $hostsPath"
    exit 1
}

foreach ($domain in $Domains) {
    $domain = $domain.Trim()
    if (!$domain) { continue }

    # Check if already blocked
    $already = Get-Content -Path $hostsPath | Where-Object { $_ -match "^\s*127\.0\.0\.1\s+$domain\s*$" }

        Write-Host "$domain is already blocked."
        continue
    }

    Add-Content -Path $hostsPath -Value "127.0.0.1`t$domain"
    Write-Host "Blocked $domain."
}

Write-Host "`nFinished. You may need to flush the DNS cache:"
Write-Host "    ipconfig /flushdns"

# Usage: sudo ./block-ip.sh 203.0.113.45

TARGET=$1

# Insert rule at the top of the OUTPUT chain
